responsibility: Implements allocation, reuse, duplication, and metadata management for SSA_NAME nodes on a per-function basis. It maintains the SSA-name vector and freelists, creates and copies SSA names and version numbers, duplicates pointer and range metadata, resets flow-sensitive facts such as ranges and pointer alignment/nonnull information, releases defs and compacts dead SSA-name holes, and provides verification and statistics for SSA-name lifetime management used throughout tree-SSA construction and optimization.
same_name_distinction: This .c file implements per-function SSA_NAME lifecycle management, including allocation and freelist reuse, copying/duplication, flow-sensitive metadata reset, dead-name release, compaction, and the release_ssa pass. Unlike gcc/tree-ssanames.h, it is not the public API/metadata-definition header exposing ptr_info_def, SSANAMES accessors, and helper declarations.
